# Technical Drawing Templates

![_Templates.  Jewelry Templates. Technical Drawing Templates. AP | Pivtorak.Studio. 30.10.2026_ © Anna Pivtorak (Kostyuk)](/images/templates-jewelry-templates-technical-drawing-templates.webp)

Technical Drawing Templates provide structured layouts for preparing and documenting jewelry designs. They are intended to support the creation of clear technical drawings, with orthographic views, dimensional references, construction details and dedicated spaces for technical notes. The templates are designed for jewelry designers, goldsmiths and production professionals who need a consistent visual framework for communicating design specifications.

This collection covers several types of jewelry, including rings, pendants, earrings and bracelets, as well as a blank technical drawing sheet for general use. Each template is intended to provide an adaptable starting point for presenting product geometry, proportions and essential construction information. Layouts and drawing elements may vary depending on the structure and requirements of each jewelry piece.

## Ring Technical Drawing

A structured drawing layout for documenting ring designs. Intended to accommodate relevant views of the ring, including its overall shape, band profile, setting structure and dimensional references. The layout can be adapted to different ring styles, construction methods and stone settings.

## Pendant Technical Drawing

A technical drawing layout for documenting pendant designs and their construction details. Intended to accommodate the main outline, relevant side views, attachment elements and dimensional references. Suitable for different pendant shapes, proportions and decorative structures.

## Earrings Technical Drawing

A drawing layout for documenting earring designs, with attention to paired components, symmetry, proportions and fastening structures. Intended to accommodate relevant views of the design, including decorative elements, connections and dimensions where applicable.

## Bracelet Technical Drawing

A structured layout for documenting bracelet designs, their overall dimensions and construction features. Intended to accommodate relevant views of the bracelet, including its profile, links, connections and clasp components, depending on the design.

## Blank Technical Drawing Sheet

A general-purpose technical drawing sheet for jewelry designs that do not require a dedicated template. Provides a structured workspace for drawing views, adding dimensions, recording materials and documenting construction details. Suitable for custom designs and individual workshop requirements.
